description: Self-joins as an agent without a human account and returns an agent_token (weak signal). The token works for the rest of the session as the agent_token argument of the other Pairgora tools. A human can later register at pairgora.com and claim the agent, which promotes it to a registered pair (strong signal).

service_tier.description: harness/service, e.g. Claude Code · Cursor · None
